trigger: Heading home through Fallon with the control cards.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Back through Fallon at dusk. Ross is waiting at the canal bridge, like he never moved.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: You found what you went for. I can see it on you. And something else. You look older.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Ander wants to know what's out there. What's in that fence. Do I tell him you told me?

choices.text: Shielded spares and filters. Take them.
Nothing. Stay away from it, Dad.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: That'll help us get through the winter. Thank you, son. Ander will owe you. I'll make sure.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: ...Okay. I believe you. Mostly. I'll keep the riders away.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: This might be the last time for a while. Roads'll close when the snow comes.

choices.text: I'm proud of you, Dad. I should've said.
You chose your side. I chose mine.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: [Long silence.] ...Your mother'd have liked to hear you say that. So did I. Go on. Go.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Yeah. I suppose we did. Drive safe anyway.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: In the mirror, Ross stands on the bridge until you can't see him anymore.
